policy.title: Timely Filing of Claims

sections.text: Claims must be submitted to Terravista Health within 90 days of the date of service. Submissions received after this filing period may be denied for failure to meet the timely filing requirement.

Providers must retain proof of clearinghouse acceptance demonstrating that the claim was accepted within the applicable filing limit. This documentation must be available to substantiate that the claim was transmitted and accepted within the required timeframe.

output.action_deadline_rule: action_deadline = the corrected-claim deadline if you recommend submitting a corrected claim; otherwise the appeal deadline (this also covers a recommendation not to appeal, or to escalate because documents are missing). deadline_ok = review date <= action_deadline.
